verdict.rationale: CrewAI is installed as a local Python/CLI framework (`uv tool install crewai`) and runs crews/flows entirely in your own code and infrastructure; the managed 'CrewAI AMP' deployment option is explicitly optional, separate from the open-source core (crewai-docs-15, crewai-docs-32, crewai-docs-8, crewai-docs-55). Community usage (crewai-comm-1) shows people running crews locally with their own models/tools, confirming no vendor-platform dependency for core operation. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/production deployment guide, licensing details, and independent large-scale case studies of fully vendor-free production deployments.
